name: paper-distill
description: Pure v3 research vault with qmd-backed retrieval, approved arXiv capture, and Python-tool writes.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, capture, search, and maintain a qmd-backed research vault.
interface.longDescription: Paper Distill v3 stages candidate papers for human approval, captures approved arXiv source material into qmd-backed vault notes, retrieves pages through search/get tools, and writes updates through Python MCP tools for lint/status/index workflows.
defaultPrompt: Discover new VLA papers and stage them in my inbox.
Ingest approved arXiv papers into qmd-backed source notes.
Search my v3 vault and get the exact qmd page I need.
Run lint, status, and index maintenance on my research vault.
